title: Monday Morning Intelligence Brief — Week of November 17, 2026

watchlist.topic: Indian student interest in South Korean technical programmes
watchlist.why_watch: Rising inquiries or application spikes would justify scaling the K-CORE advisory module.

watchlist.topic: Yocket pricing adjustments or new feature releases
watchlist.why_watch: Changes could accelerate competitive pressure and require rapid response.

opportunities.title: Add South Korea K-CORE to advisory portfolio
opportunities.impact: Potential to generate an additional 5‑10% of total revenue within 12‑18 months by capturing placement commissions from a new destination.
opportunities.evidence: South Korea’s K-CORE scheme offers Indian students two‑year technical courses with employment pathways (educationtimes.com).
opportunities.next_step: Commission a rapid market‑size assessment of Indian interest in K-CORE and draft a pilot advisory module.

opportunities.title: Introduce bundled premium packages to counter Yocket
opportunities.impact: Improves cross‑sell rates, could lift counseling‑package revenue from 25% to ~35% and reduce churn.
opportunities.evidence: Yocket’s integrated platform bundles counseling, test‑prep and finance services (yocket.com).
opportunities.next_step: Run a pricing and feature audit of Yocket’s bundles; prototype a MeetUniversity “All‑In‑One” package.

executive_summary: South Korea's K-CORE scheme opens a new government‑backed destination for Indian students, creating a niche revenue opportunity.
Yocket has launched an integrated all‑in‑one platform bundling counseling, test‑prep and finance services, raising competitive pressure.
MeetUniversity’s revenue mix remains heavily weighted to university placement commissions (65%), with modest growth in test‑prep partnerships.
Top destination demand continues to be UK and Canada, but early signals show expanding interest in Germany and Ireland.
No major customer‑facing complaints or churn signals detected this week.

risks_and_threats.title: Competitive encroachment by Yocket’s bundled offering
risks_and_threats.possible_impact: May divert price‑sensitive students, erode placement commission volume, and pressure margins.

items.evidence: STUDY ABROAD: South Korea’s K-CORE scheme offers Indian students two-year technical courses with employment pathways (educationtimes.com)
items.what_changed: Launch of K-CORE offering Indian students two‑year technical degrees, language training, and direct industrial job pathways.
items.strategic_relevance: Creates a fresh, high‑growth destination that MeetUniversity can add to its portfolio, capture placement commissions, and differentiate via specialised advisory content.

market_intelligence.summary: South Korea introduced the K-CORE scheme, a government‑backed pathway for Indian students into two‑year technical degrees with employment outcomes.

recommended_actions.title: Kick‑off market‑size study for K-CORE
recommended_actions.reason: Validate demand before investing resources; early mover advantage could secure partnership commissions.

recommended_actions.title: Commission competitive audit of Yocket’s bundles
recommended_actions.reason: Quantify pricing and feature gaps to inform our own bundled product design.

recommended_actions.title: Develop outreach plan to Korean junior colleges
recommended_actions.reason: Secure referral agreements that translate into placement commissions.

internal_intelligence.summary: Revenue composition remains dominated by university placement commissions (65%), with counseling packages at 25% and test‑prep partnerships at 10%; mix stable over the past 12 months.

items.evidence: Your All-in-One Platform for Studying Abroad ... Yocket Premium ... Yocket Prep ... Yocket Finance (yocket.com)
items.implications: Potential shift of price‑sensitive students to Yocket; pressure to revisit product bundling and pricing to protect market share.
items.what_changed: Launch of an integrated platform that bundles premium counseling, test‑prep, and education‑finance services.
items.why_it_matters: The bundled value proposition simplifies the decision process for students and highlights large placement numbers, directly competing with MeetUniversity’s à la carte model.

competitor_intelligence.summary: Yocket is positioning a bundled premium offering that could erode MeetUniversity’s market share.
